title: WINDOW_PATTERN all-short (SSSS)
description: Changed WINDOW_PATTERN from 'SSSL' to 'SSSS' at DEPTH=9 baseline: only the code-forced last layer keeps full-context attention, all other 8 layers use half-context sliding window (was 3 of 9 layers long, now 1 of 9). Reduces attention FLOPs, all else unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 0.998440, beating the 0.998924 baseline by ~0.0005 -- a small but real win, consistent with the round's emerging pattern that reducing per-step compute (more tok/sec) under the fixed 5-minute budget tends to help, same mechanism as the depth 10->9 win. All three other round-3 proposals were the identical untested-warmup experiment, so I deliberately picked a different axis to avoid spending the shared budget on triplicate confirmation of one cheap test. Worth a fine bracket next round (e.g. one 'L' every 8 layers vs every 4, or SSSSL vs SSSS) to see if this is a real trend or noise -- only one run here, unconfirmed.
